intro: Jorah Annison is a Forsaken cartographer stationed in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Though his profession revolves around maps and geography, his expertise proves invaluable to traveling spellcasters in search of obscure, scattered knowledge across Azeroth.

p: Dwelling amidst the alchemical vapors and arcane echoes of the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Jorah Annison plies the trade of cartography. Yet the maps bore him: Jorah would trade every one in the shop for a single good book, and he knows more of ancient texts than almost anyone, a scholar's taste he shares with the warlocks who seek him out.

Jorah's knowledge of the land extends well beyond the ruins of Lordaeron. Warlocks seeking the elusive Tome of the Cabal are frequently directed to him to uncover where ancient texts and remnants of dark sects might be salvaged, bridging the gap between historical lore and distant geography.
